text:
maria: fyi, running into weird SSE behavior in the new sample app. after an auth refresh + reconnect, chunks arrive out of order and sometimes we render partial json twice.
maria: small tcp snippet:
```
2026-11-03T08:12:01.000Z conn open id=conn-42
2026-11-03T08:12:01.150Z sse: id=10 data={"text":"hello wor"
2026-11-03T08:12:01.260Z client disconnect: socket closed
2026-11-03T08:12:01.420Z reconnect resume_id=conn-42 last_id=10
2026-11-03T08:12:01.540Z sse: id=12 data={"text":"ld!"}
2026-11-03T08:12:01.620Z sse: id=11 data={"text":"ld"}
2026-11-03T08:12:01.700Z sse: id=12 data={"text":"ld!"} (dup)
```
maria: note: server emits an `id:` for each chunk, but fragments can be mid-json. naive client concatenation shows duplicated partials and invalid JSON until dedupe finishes.
alex: are you using EventSource wrapper or fetch+reader? which SDK version?
maria: fetch+reader in browser-sdk v0.9.8-beta. sample-app code:
```
const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${t}` } });
const rd = r.body.getReader();
while(true){ const {done, value} = await rd.read(); if(done) break; appendChunk(value); }
```
maria: we do a naive append and then try JSON.parse when braces match. race yields duplicate fragments.
sam: two layers: transport races (old socket still getting data) and auth refresh causing back-to-back reconnects. client may open a new connection before old one fully drained. also proxies can reorder.
kelsey: infra note: proxy we use in CI (envoy) can multiplex but should not reorder within a single HTTP/1.1 conn. however multiple conns to the same origin can show interleaving at the application layer if server emits the same tail to both. server should avoid double-emitting after resume.
alex: client mitigations: 1) preserve last `id` and send `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect; 2) buffer fragments and apply in-order by id (small reordering window, with a flush timeout); 3) de-dupe by id+hash; 4) treat mid-json fragments carefully — prefer to reassemble using explicit ids rather than raw append.
maria: implemented a quick buffer with 500ms flush and de-dupe LRU(64). duplicates dropped but occasional ordering gap remains when seq jumps (e.g., 10 -> 12 -> 11).
sam: add jittered reconnect backoff on auth refresh so we don't spin multiple reconnects. also make SDK emit an event when it detects out-of-order id so apps can surface telemetry.
kelsey: infra follow-up: i'll add a server-side guard that, on resume, marks old connections as standby and stops writing chunks once the resumed stream has acknowledged receipt. i'll also review proxy configs for premature connection reuse.
deploy-bot: sample-app-ci #810 passed (tests: 98) :white_check_mark:
alex: proposal for SDK: expose streaming option `resumePolicy: "strict" | "best-effort"` where strict requires Last-Event-ID and in-order enforcement (client buffers+timeouts) and best-effort mirrors current behavior. default remains best-effort for compat.
maria: +1, i'll open a PR in browser-sdk with `resumePolicy` and a small demo in sample-app. i'll attach the tcp capture and a minimal reproducer.
sam: thanks — also file an infra ticket referencing this thread so runtime team can implement the emission guard. good catch.
